Per run: `run` is GET .../actions/runs/<id> (the LATEST attempt, as a listing row shows it), trimmed to the listing row's fields. For ci.yml also `attempt_1` (GET .../runs/<id>/attempts/1, trimmed the same way), `attempt_1_jobs` and `attempt_2_jobs` (GET .../runs/<id>/attempts/<n>/jobs?per_page=100). For ci-next.yml `jobs` is GET .../runs/<id>/jobs?filter=latest&per_page=100. Each job is trimmed to the fields the other fixtures keep, with its `steps`. `annotations` is GET .../check-runs/<job id>/annotations?per_page=100 of build-and-test on attempt 1 (114227408794: the red pass's notice, reason=failed) and on attempt 2 (114236735476: both passes' notices), and of unit-utc-cov and unit-ny, each annotation trimmed to the fields the other fixtures keep. Nothing is edited: attempt 2's two digests are byte-equal to the shadow's, node_files 0 against 503.
